Variants.Content: The Neck is a vast wetland with mires, reeds, shallow lakes, forest islands and changing waterways that make fixed maps quickly outdated. The north-south road was compressed near the causeway. Heavy cavalry, convoys and strangers who left the road were easily trapped in mud, poisonous insects and disease. The Rider family and the people of the marsh used boats, spears, bows and arrows, nets and local knowledge to live their lives. It is said that Greywater Watch will move with floating islands and waterways, making it difficult for outsiders to find it. The power of Neck lies not in the open battle, but in concealment, misdirection, consumption and choosing when to show up. Those who try to rule here can only occupy a few dry lands without local cooperation.

The people of the swamp know the way by the sound of frogs, water plants and the color of mud. Outsiders laugh at them for being short and hidden, while they watch the tall knight sink into a land they don't understand step by step.

The northern lords regard the Neck as a natural moat and must respect the independent habits of the Li De family. If the order is not suitable for the wetland, the people of the wetland will silence it and make it disappear.
Those who come from the south are most afraid of invisible enemies and endless muddy water. Armor, money, and maps are not as useful as a trusted guide in the Neck.
